nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name, set to 'toebeans' in the constructor.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol, set to 'beans' in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable holding the token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint256 _totalSupply holding the minted supply, returned (minus balances[address(0)]) by totalSupply().
Mapping(address => uint) of token balances, written by the constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of allowances, written by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor that sets name, symbol, decimals and mints the entire _totalSupply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
View function returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Public function writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no checks and emitting Approval.
Public function debiting balances[msg.sender] with safeSub and crediting balances[to] with safeAdd, then emitting Transfer.
Public function debiting balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] with safeSub and crediting balances[to] with safeAdd, emitting Transfer.
Library function computing c = a + b and requiring c >= a.
Library function requiring b <= a then computing c = a - b.
Library function computing c = a * b and requiring a == 0 || c / a == b.
Library function requiring b > 0 then computing c = a / b.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller used for minting, allowancing and balance debiting.
Addition c = a + b in safeAdd, only guarded afterwards by require(c >= a).
Subtraction c = a - b in safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b in safeMul, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division c = a / b in safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
Initial mint balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply in the constructor.
balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) followed by balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) in transfer.
balances[from] = safeSub(...), allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(...) and balances[to] = safeAdd(...) in transferFrom.
address tokenOwner parameter of balanceOf.
address tokenOwner parameter of allowance.
address spender parameter of allowance.
address spender parameter of approve.
uint tokens parameter of approve.
address to parameter of transfer.
uint tokens parameter of transfer.
address from parameter of transferFrom.
address to parameter of transferFrom.
uint tokens parameter of transferFrom.
uint a parameter of safeAdd.
uint b parameter of safeAdd.
uint a parameter of safeSub.
uint b parameter of safeSub.
uint a parameter of safeMul.
uint b parameter of safeMul.
uint a parameter of safeDiv.
uint b parameter of safeDiv.
Local result variable c in safeAdd.
Local result variable c in safeSub.
Local result variable c in safeMul.
Local result variable c in safeDiv.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the deployer whose balance slot is credited with _totalSupply in the constructor.
The deploying msg.sender triggers the constructor execution.
msg.sender is used as the owner key of allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
msg.sender's balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender's allowance slot allowed[from][msg.sender] is debited in transferFrom.
msg.sender unconditionally receives the full initial supply with no ownership or allowlist restriction.
constructor assigns name = 'toebeans'.
constructor assigns symbol = 'beans'.
constructor assigns decimals = 18.
constructor assigns _totalSupply.
constructor writes balances[msg.sender].
constructor executes the initial mint operation.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without bound checks.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer performs the debit and credit balance update operation.
transfer internally calls safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transfer internally calls safeSub for the sender debit.
safeSub executes before safeAdd inside transfer.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom performs the balance and allowance update operation.
transferFrom internally calls safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transferFrom internally calls safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
safeSub executions for balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] precede safeAdd in transferFrom.
safeAdd performs the addition c = a + b which can wrap before the require(c >= a) check.
The addition result is stored into local c prior to validation.
safeSub performs the subtraction c = a - b guarded only by require(b <= a).
The subtraction result is stored into local c.
safeMul performs the multiplication c = a * b guarded only by the overflow require.
The multiplication result is stored into local c.
safeDiv performs the division c = a / b guarded only by require(b > 0).
The division result is stored into local c.
tokenOwner is the only input of balanceOf.
tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is the allowance target written by approve.
tokens is the unbounded allowance value written by approve.
to is the credited account in transfer.
tokens is the amount transferred in transfer.
from is the debited account in transferFrom.
to is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens is the amount transferred in transferFrom.
a is the first operand of safeAdd.
b is the second operand of safeAdd.
a is the minuend of safeSub.
b is the subtrahend of safeSub.
a is the first factor of safeMul.
b is the second factor of safeMul.
a is the dividend of safeDiv.
b is the divisor of safeDiv.
